title: spec: retire PositionGrantVia 'name' (the position-name fold's grant mark) once #24757's runtime retirement lands
body:
Carries the spec and UI half of #24757 (the published `PositionGrantVia` member that describes the position-name fold). #24757 keeps the runtime retirement in `plugin-security` (the resolver's position-name request, `dropDeactivatedFoldedSets`, the warning, the delegation walk, explain, the collision gate). Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `os-project-manager` · session `session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`. ⛔ Not a claim. Domain, grade and route are triage's.

**Why this is split off:** #24757's dev found, before any edit, that the fold has a published spec member. Under the server lane's fence (a card touching `packages/spec` belongs to the spec seat), the server PR retires the runtime only. This card carries the rest.

**Measured on `origin/main` `b0384f3f` (the #24757 dev's pre-claim reading):**
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts:130`: `export type PositionGrantVia = 'definition' | 'name'`. The docblock at :119-129 defines `name` as the grant the resolver's position-name fold makes when the definition does not list the set.
- It types `PositionGrantSummary.permissionSets[].via` (`ISecurityService.describePositionGrants`).
- Served as `_grantedPermissionSets` on `GET /meta/position?include=grants` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` ~:3407).
- Rendered by `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionGrantCells.tsx`, the "(by name)" / "（同名）" badge, with i18n keys `engine.position.grants.byName` and `byNameHint`.

**The ask:** once #24757's PR has merged, nothing produces `via: 'name'`. Retire the `'name'` member and its docblock (narrowing `PositionGrantVia` to `'definition'`), and drop the UI badge and its two i18n keys. Until then, the spec declares a value the runtime no longer emits.

**Ruling it carries:** #13419 ruling B (`5472608110`, the name-fold channel retires), shipped in 18.x under 「甲」 as amended (#6015 `6303865025`). No new decision is needed.

Blocked-by: #24757
